prompt: Two equivalents of a thiol (2 RSH) are oxidized (NaOH/H₂O/Br₂) to give what?

options.label: A disulfide, R-S-S-R, with reduction of Br₂ to 2 Br⁻

explanation: Thiols are easily oxidized to disulfides (2 R-SH → R-S-S-R + 2 e⁻ + 2 H⁺). Biologically crucial — this is the chemistry of cysteine → cystine, which stabilizes protein tertiary structure (e.g., insulin). Reduction (Zn/HCl, DTT, or TCEP) regenerates thiols.
